headline: Congress named a Missouri post office after Lance Corporal Phillip Vinnedge.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 5323 Highway N in Cottleville, Missouri, as the "Lance Corporal Phillip Vinnedge Post Office." It is a naming change only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or its staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 9, 2014, and the name took effect on that date.
